caseNameFull: Rosenberg v. United States and Sobell v. United States
attorneys: Emanuel H. Bloch for petitioners in No. 111., Howard N. Meyer for petitioner in No. 112., Solicitor General Perlman, Assistant Attorney General McInerney, Robert S. Erdahl and John R. Wilkins for the United States.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. The motion in No. 111 for leave to file brief of National Lawyers Guild, as amicus curiae, is denied. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion the petitions should be granted.

Reported below: 195 F. 2d 583.
